rules_verbatim: t 单独的覆盖率 ≥ 93%；Δ 为 ±0.02 与 ±0.03 时，t 单独的判等价比例 ≤ 3.0%；A4 必须 100% 退化、0% 判等价；退化重复按“不判等价、覆盖为真”计。quality_equivalence_enabled 取全部验收场景都通过且全部运行完整时的逻辑与；任一场景不通过或未完成，即为 false。
trial_policy: Each row: 10000 t-only calls plus 1 full shared 20000-resample envelope call, timing only. Project formal t and envelope costs separately; sum all rows. If >12 hours no formal repeats.
